text: レッドくんの　こと　すこし　にらんで　いるみたい…　もうすこし　かわいがって　あげられない　かしら？

structure.jp: レッドくんの　こと　すこし　にらんで　いるみたい…
structure.en: it seems to be glaring at you a little, Red…

structure.jp: もうすこし　かわいがって　あげられない　かしら？
structure.en: couldn't you be a bit more loving to it, I wonder?

patterns.name: 〜みたい
patterns.span: にらんで　いるみたい
patterns.explanation: みたい after a phrase means 'it looks like' or 'it seems'. にらんで　いるみたい = 'it seems to be glaring'.

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.span: かわいがって　あげられない
patterns.explanation: あげる after a て-form verb means doing something kind for another; here it is in the 'can't' form, used as a gentle request. かわいがって　あげられない = 'can't you be loving to it'.

patterns.name: 〜かしら
patterns.span: あげられない　かしら
patterns.explanation: かしら is a soft, feminine 'I wonder', which makes the request gentle. あげられない　かしら = 'couldn't you, I wonder'.
